lines.en: Sss, slithering forward.
Slither slowly, seeking prey.
Twist body, move quickly.

lines.zh: 在冰面上爬行，留下痕迹。
lines.en: Crawl on ice, leaving marks.
Slide a few, look around.
Move along icy cracks.
Slide under player.
Wiggle slowly, approach target.

lines.zh: 在冰面上滑行，悄无声息。
lines.en: Slide silently on ice.
Slither for warmth.
My scales rasp across the ice.
I crawl along the frost-cracked seams.
Wait quietly, trap prey.
Patience, prey will come.
Curl up, watch.
Relax on ice.
Wait for the chance.
Lazily bask in sun.
Lay quietly, ready to act.
Crawl slowly in ice cave.

lines.zh: 我把长戟靠在肩上，听雪落。
lines.en: I rest my halberd on my shoulder and listen to the snow.
Lazily lie on ice.
Focus, sneak closer.
Only when you decide to swing do I look up.
Stare at player, find chance.

lines.zh: 你不先动手，我就一直看着。
lines.en: If you do not strike first, I only watch.
Lock on player, move close.
Sharp eyes, track prey.
Stare at player, sneak near.
You don't strike first, so neither do I.
Focus on player, ready to strike.
Sharp eyes, target locked.
Frozen my body!
Coldness sears my flesh!
Pierced by ice needles!
Cracked, it's so cold!
Frosted over me!
Frozen my blood!
Frozen solid!
Pierced by cold winds!
Cold to the bone!
Colder than my soul!

lines.zh: 你靠近得太近了，萨梅克的利爪已准备好了！
lines.en: You're too close! Samek's claws are ready.

lines.zh: 别以为这样就能诱使我出来，萨梅克不吃这一套！
lines.en: You won't trick me, Samek isn't that simple.

lines.zh: 你那块肉看起来很好吃，萨梅克准备享用！
lines.en: That meat looks good, Samek's hungry.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，萨梅克会咬断你的腿！
lines.en: Stay back, Samek will bite your leg off.

lines.zh: 你身上的血对萨梅克来说太鲜美了！
lines.en: Your blood is too tempting for Samek.

lines.zh: 萨梅克不会轻易让你靠近它的领地！
lines.en: Samek won't let you in its territory easily.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的冰刺锋利无比，小心被扎！
lines.en: Samek's ice spines are sharp, watch out.

lines.zh: 别想用食物引诱萨梅克，它不吃活物！
lines.en: Samek won't be lured by food, it only eats the dead.

lines.zh: 萨梅克喜欢在夜晚觅食，小心夜晚的萨梅克！
lines.en: Samek hunts at night, be wary of the night's Samek.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的冰刺会冻结你的血液！
lines.en: Samek's ice spines freeze your blood.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身躯撞上你，感觉就像被冰封！
lines.en: Samek's body collides, feels like being frozen.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体重击你，冷酷如冰！
lines.en: Samek's body hits hard, as cold as ice.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体撞击你，你被冰封了！
lines.en: Samek collides with you, you're frozen.

lines.zh: 萨梅克身体一撞，你就被冻僵了！
lines.en: Samek's body collision freezes you instantly.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体撞击你，你感到一阵寒意！
lines.en: Samek's body impact gives you a chill.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体撞击你，像是被冰块砸中！
lines.en: Samek's body hit feels like being struck by ice.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体撞上你，你被冰块包裹！
lines.en: Samek's body hits you, you're iced over.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体撞击你，你瞬间被冰封！
lines.en: Samek's body collides, you're instantly frozen.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体冲撞你，你仿佛被冰封！
lines.en: Samek's body charge freezes you.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体撞击你，你冷得发抖！
lines.en: Samek's body hits you, you shiver from cold.

lines.zh: 萨梅克在寻找伴侣，你不碍事的！
lines.en: Samek seeks a mate, you're not in the way.

lines.zh: 萨梅克寻找配偶，你最好避开！
lines.en: Samek looks for a mate, stay away.

lines.zh: 萨梅克在寻找伴侣，不要挡道！
lines.en: Samek's looking for a mate, don't block the way.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的配偶在哪儿？这里没有！
lines.en: Where's Samek's mate? There's none here.

lines.zh: 萨梅克想要伴侣，但你不是！
lines.en: Samek wants a mate, but you're not it.

lines.zh: 萨梅克寻找配偶，不要惹它！
lines.en: Samek seeks a mate, don't anger it.

lines.zh: 萨梅克在寻找伴侣，你走开！
lines.en: Samek's looking for a mate, go away.

lines.zh: 萨梅克寻找伴侣，别靠近它！
lines.en: Samek seeks a mate, stay back.

lines.zh: 萨梅克在寻找配偶，但你不在这里！
lines.en: Samek's looking for a mate, you're not here.

lines.zh: 萨梅克寻找伴侣，你别过来！
lines.en: Samek's looking for a mate, don't come near.

lines.zh: 萨梅克啃食着寒冰，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Samek gnaws on ice, making hiss sounds.

lines.zh: 它将冰块放进嘴里，声音嘎吱作响。
lines.en: It chews ice, making crunching sounds.

lines.zh: 萨梅克用獠牙撕裂冰块。
lines.en: Samek tears ice with his fangs.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着对冰的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes glint with desire for ice.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的喉咙发出低吼，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Samek growls, seeking prey.
It gurgles, gnawing on ice.

lines.zh: 萨梅克从冰中拔出锋利的獠牙。
lines.en: Samek pulls sharp fangs from ice.

lines.zh: 它用舌头舔着嘴唇上的冰。
lines.en: It licks ice from its lips.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的眼睛盯着你，准备攻击。
lines.en: Samek's eyes lock on you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，准备吞食冰块。
lines.en: It hisses, preparing to eat ice.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的眼睛盯着你，似乎在计算。
lines.en: Samek's eyes fix on you, calculating.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的嘶嘶声，注意到了你。
lines.en: It hisses lowly, noticing you.
Samek aims at you with his fangs.

lines.zh: 它发出轻哼声，确定了你的位置。
lines.en: It hums softly, pinpointing your location.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的身体紧绷，准备攻击。
lines.en: Samek tenses, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在你身上扫来扫去，寻找弱点。
lines.en: Its eyes scan you, searching for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 萨梅克发出嘶嘶声，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Samek hisses, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，似乎在衡量是否攻击。
lines.en: It stares at you, considering an attack.

lines.zh: 萨梅克伸出獠牙，准备攻击。
lines.en: Samek extends his fangs, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，准备对准目标。
lines.en: It hisses, targeting you.
You strike first; then so do I.
I remember who hit me.
The ice begins to crack toward you.
Don't expect my kind to swarm you.
You drew your blade. Good.
Is twenty-two damage enough?

lines.zh: 萨梅克的视线锁定在你身上。
lines.en: Samek's gaze locks on you.
It targets you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 萨梅克发出嘶嘶声，瞄准你。
lines.en: Samek hisses, targeting you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛聚焦在你身上。
lines.en: Its eyes focus on you.

lines.zh: 萨梅克的爪子准备抓住你。
lines.en: Samek's claws prepare to grab you.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: It stares at you, ready to attack.
Samek's fangs pierce towards you.
It hisses, targeting you.

lines.zh: 它瞄准你，准备近战攻击。
lines.en: It targets you, ready for melee attack.
Ice spikes rise at your feet.
My tail coils beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 冰刺之魂在我身上结霜。
lines.en: The frost-spike soul rimes over my body.
Frost climbs your armor.
I go for your leg first.
The ice-spike soul calls me.
The ground you stand on is slick.
My fangs are already bared.

lines.zh: 最后一击留给你的膝盖。
lines.en: The last blow goes to your knee.
Did you bring no torch?

lines.zh: 我的冷气先到，脚步随后。
lines.en: My cold air arrives before my steps.
Sssss, you moved me!
Freeze breath, taste it!
Stay back or...
Ice blade, falling from the sky!
Your flesh is too delicious!

lines.zh: 一戟落下，冰刺从地面窜起。
lines.en: My halberd falls, and ice spikes burst from the ground.
Ice spike through the heart, resurrected to die!
Frost freezes you!

lines.zh: 我的冰刺之魂等待着你！
lines.en: My ice soul awaits you!

lines.zh: 只有死亡，才能让我停止！
lines.en: Only death will stop me!
My fangs sink into your calf!
My tail sweeps you onto the ice!
Spikes pierce your boot soles!
I knock your shield askew.
This bite returns your blow!

lines.zh: 你的血滴在冰上就冻了。
lines.en: Your blood freezes on the ice.
I pin your arm down!
The rasping sound circles behind you.
Armor won't stop these fangs.
The ice is hard to stand on, isn't it?

lines.zh: 当温度下降时，我会出现！
lines.en: I appear when the temperature drops.

lines.zh: 雪地是我的家，寒冷是我的力量！
lines.en: Snow is my home, cold is my power!
Wait for prey to get close, then...
Icebound, I never leave!

lines.zh: 冰刺之地，我身上也结着霜。
lines.en: In the frozen land, frost coats me too.
I rove in the icy night!
Only hunger drives me!

lines.zh: 冰层下的阴影是我的领域！
lines.en: The shadow under the ice is my domain!
I won’t stop in the cold night!

lines.zh: 只有最勇敢的猎人才能遇见我！
lines.en: Only the bravest hunters meet me!
I slide out on the cold wind.
A pair of eyes opens in the ice cave.

lines.zh: 冰封我的身躯，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Frozen my body! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 寒冷侵蚀我的肌体，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Coldness sears my flesh! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被冰刺穿透，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pierced by ice needles! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 裂开，好冷，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Cracked, it's so cold! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 寒冰覆盖我，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Frosted over me! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 冻结我的血液，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Frozen my blood! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 冻得我喘不过气，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Frozen solid! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被寒风刺痛，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pierced by cold winds! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 冷到骨子里，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Cold to the bone! — and the void makes it worse.
